title: Chapter 146: Sacrifice Ceremony Of The Evil God
content:
Chapter 146: Sacrifice Ceremony Of The Evil God

Wu Qing had seen some introductions to the evil god sacrifice ceremony in the books he bought.

The evil god sacrifice ceremony is hosted by the priests who believe in the evil god. The evil god priests consume the energy of faith, use magic to communicate with the evil god, and offer the prepared sacrifices to the evil god.

The evil god will give some feedback based on the quality of the sacrifice, which is the gift of the evil god.

This kind of feedback from the evil god is very uncertain, and it seems to depend on the character and mood of the evil god, which is a test of luck.

But in general, it is related to the quality of the sacrifice. High-quality sacrifices can sometimes bring unimaginable benefits.

High-level sacrifice ceremonies can even convey some information to the evil god, so as to get what they want.

Many evil gods are very generous to their believers. As long as the requirements are not too outrageous, they will generally respond to any request.

…

If the evil god sacrifice ceremony is really being held in the city, headed by a high priest of at least three stars, and a large number of one-star and two-star priests jointly presided over, the scale of such sacrifice is very grand.

From the fact that they were unwilling to waste even a bit of their faith energy on the army, it can be seen that they were planning a big deal this time.

As long as the sacrifices were good, they would definitely get the desired gift from the evil god.

The evil god who claimed to be omnipotent, who knows what terrible things he would come up with!

The city was a bit large, and the one-star host fully activated his stealth talent and flew into the city.

In such a city protected by the evil god, Wu Qing would never send a one-star host into the city in a non-wartime state.

Sending a one-star host into the city now was also a risk. Wu Qing was a little worried if he didn't find those evil god priests.

He asked the Queen of Insects to personally control the one-star host, ready to confront the evil god's means at any time to see how deep the influence of those evil gods on this world was.

The one-star host had a strong detection ability. It only went a little deeper into the city and detected the location of the priests in the city.

The evil god priests held the evil god sacrifice ceremony, and they didn't think of concealing it. It was carried out openly in the large square in the center of the city.

The densely packed elites of the evil god army surrounded the entire square.

In the center of the square, a high platform was built. On the platform, a high priest in a white robe led a group of priests in gray robes to kneel and pray to a religious instrument.

On the other side of the religious instrument, there was a group of humanoid creatures covered with black cloth. There were nearly 5,000 of them, all kneeling motionlessly on the ground. These were all sacrifices for this sacrificial ceremony.

This evil god sacrificial ceremony should have been going on for some time. The Queen of Insects could sense through the one-star host that the entire square was shrouded by the mysterious power of the evil god.

At this time, anyone who wanted to disrupt the evil god sacrificial ceremony would be fighting with the evil god in the air, and they would not know how they died.

Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects had a contact with this evil god. They felt that with the Queen of Insects' current strength, the result would not be too good if they rushed up directly, so they did not act rashly.

Wu Qing discovered that because of the powerful law of cause and effect of the system, the evil god priests consumed the energy of faith here, and the system could also harvest a large amount of Qi resources.

As long as the hostile relationship is established, the causal relationship is established. The system will benefit from all the enemy's consumption, and Wu Qing does not need to worry about it.

The offerings in the evil god sacrifice ceremony are still there, which means that the ceremony will take some time. Judging from the posture, this sacrifice is for a request, and the priests are constantly communicating with the evil god and conveying information.

This evil god sacrifice ceremony cannot be interrupted, and we can't just wait here.

There are so many elite troops from the evil god camp gathered in the square. The evil god army, which is now fighting the Zerg army, lacks this part of the elite and lacks the faith blessing of the priests. It is a good time to harvest vigorously.

Wu Qing asked the Queen of the Zerg to monitor the evil god sacrifice ceremony. He withdrew his consciousness and returned to the Zerg clone on the battlefield.

"Wu Cong, the defense in the city is empty now, you can join the battle!"

"You can fight freely, with the first goal of destroying the enemy's living force!"

"There will be a fierce battle today! You must preserve your strength!"

Wu Qing issued a combat order to the Wu Cong who was on standby beside him.

The two thousand powerful Daxia human army needs to regain its former glory from the battlefield!

"Yes! Guarantee to complete the mission!"

Wu Cong received the order loudly!

"Go!"

Two thousand black-armored human army shot into the city like a sharp arrow, at an incredible speed!

"The army of Daxia has joined the battle!"

Meng and Hu Wei and other alliance lords saw this scene and couldn't help but start to rub their hands and get ready!

"The strength of this human army is too strong!"

Yu Chong stared at the Daxia human army rushing into the city and said.

"Of course! Too weak an army is not worthy of fighting side by side with the Zerg!"

Meng was not surprised that Wu Qing had such a strong army under his command.

"Everyone cheer up, it's our turn to go on stage soon!"

Meng shouted to everyone.

Now that the Zerg army has almost entered the city, it is impossible for the elite troops of the alliance to stand here and watch the show.

Meng's judgment was very accurate. After a while, Wu Qing's order came.

Wu Qing ordered the elite troops of the alliance to quickly enter the city to assist the Zerg Zerglings in the battle, but they were not allowed to participate in close combat.

"All units should use long-range attacks to support the Zerg close combat troops! Do you understand?"

"Don't disobey orders! Do what you should do!"

"On the battlefield! Who dares to mess around privately! I will kill him first!"

Meng was full of vigor and solemnly conveyed the combat order to all the lords, and once again emphasized the seriousness of the military order.

This was the first time for everyone to fight together. If they didn't make things clear in advance, something would happen on the battlefield, which would have a great impact.

Meng himself was actually shocked by Wu Qing's hidden momentum. He believed that the lords of the alliance felt the same and did not dare to make trouble on the battlefield.

The elite troops of the alliance began to form a team and entered the city from the opened city gate to participate in the siege.

Wu Qing's insect clone also led his personal guards to climb the city wall and observe the battlefield situation from a high position.

Outside the city, there were only more than 100,000 ordinary troops from various territories of the alliance. Their strength and equipment were not good, and they were not qualified to participate in such a war.

But they were very excited to witness such a war. Seeing the Zerg army and the elite troops of the alliance enter the city like this, they were also very proud in their hearts.

In the lives of ordinary people, what they hear most is how many territories the evil god army has occupied, and it is almost unheard of that anyone has recaptured territory from the evil god camp.

They are also considered to be a part of the creation of this miracle. With this experience, their lives are destined to be extraordinary!
